owner_result: Original ordinary-leader tile/citizen/focus requests forwarded once with native arity0 preserved; independent actual debit/ownership/lock/focus effects verified. Source174 White refusals were a separate saved world.
lessons: A synchronous handler and even a native request can finish before game state changes. Preserve immediate old state, perform independent readback and never replay a write solely because its same-block snapshot is old.
Executor and UI contexts have different globals. Qualify actual context contracts before using UI-only guard getters; preserve owner diagnostic failures separately from product behavior.
Ordinary controls need adequate actual resources and real native target-list membership; guarded refusal alone is not a compatibility positive control.
